name: vLLM sampling-parameter max_tokens histogram
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: request_tokens. Bucket bounds are build_1_2_5_buckets(max_model_len), so they DEPEND on the served model's context length; the list here is the ladder for a model with an 8192-token context.
